quantization.method: PT2E post-training dynamic activation/static weight quantization
quantization.calibration: The pinned prefill/decode fixtures are executed once after prepare_pt2e. Weights are calibrated/frozen per output channel; activation qparams are computed dynamically for each invocation, so no static activation ranges are reused.

criteria.rationale: INT8 is evaluated against pinned eager FP32, not the FP32 delegate tolerance. Cosine >=0.99 protects direction for hidden/logit/cache vectors, aggregate NRMSE <=5% bounds energy-weighted drift, per-cache NRMSE <=12% covers low-energy value caches without hiding it, and the externally consumed greedy token must match exactly.
